sentences.text: The Collector module accepts sensor records in batches of 32.
The Collector forwards each batch to the Validator for schema checks.
The Collector is the input stage of the Aurora Pipeline.
The Validator receives batches from the Collector.
The Validator rejects records with a missing timestamp.
The Validator sends valid records to the Archive.
